text:
Sam K (Growth): Heads up team — prepping social assets + seeding plan for the May 18 performance benchmark webinar. Need to finalize: hero image, 3 micro clips (15s), alt text, employee amplification brief, and a prioritized seedlist.
Jules P (Social): I'll take amplification + scheduling. Thinking: X tease 24h before, X main at 08:30 PT, LinkedIn at 11:00 PT, and a follow-up thread 6h later. Suggest a lightweight employee advocacy message for 50 folks.
Mina H (Content): Drafted two caption directions: (1) Technical bench: "How our customers cut per-token cost — live demo May 18." (2) Human-story: "From 45ms to <10ms: the tricks teams use." Which do we want paid to push?
Sam K (Growth): Paid = technical bench. Organic = mix both. Also want a short creator brief for micro clips. I can sponsor $3k for initial seeding if Legal signs off on the 3x claim.
Legal-Bot: Auto-check: Claim "3x" requires internal benchmark doc link and reviewer. Please attach benchmark memo or change phrasing to "up to 3x".
Mina H (Content): Ok flagged. I'll update copy to "up to 3x" and upload the memo link in the campaign doc.
Ethan L (Design): Asset checklist from me: webinar-hero-wide.png (1200x628), webinar-hero-square.png (1080x1080), clip1.mp4, clip2.mp4, clip3.mp4, q-card-1.png. Alt text: I can draft alt text but need final captions for context. ETA EOD today.
Tara C (Ops): For inbound routing: create tag `webinar-may18` in HubSpot and route to SDR rotation. Also create webhook for Publish-Bot to send a slack alert to #inbound when anyone clicks register and comes from paid UTM.
Jules P (Social): Employee advocacy copy (short): "We're demoing how teams reduce inference costs — join us May 18: https://redwood.ai/may18 (UTM attached)." Keep it 1 line + 1 CTA. Who will push to folks?
Sam K (Growth): I'll own distribution to the advocacy roster. Can we include a pre-approved list of 5 top-line bullets to help employees personalize?
Mina H (Content): Adding bullets now: 1) real customer case studies 2) live demo 3) Q&A with engineering 4) actionable config tips 5) recording available.
Jules P (Social): Scheduling CSV example I'm using: 
```
post_time,platform,copy,image,utm
2026-05-18T08:30:00-07:00,X,"Technical bench short","webinar-hero-wide.png","?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may18&utm_content=paid"
2026-05-18T11:00:00-07:00,LinkedIn,"Human-story long","webinar-hero-square.png","?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may18"
```
Sam K (Growth): Seedlist: prioritize leads in infra/ML infra verticals, then cloud migrations. I'll share sanitized CSV by 10:30 PT tomorrow.
Tara C (Ops): Publish-Bot config request: set embargo to 08:25 PT, auto-post both platforms, and trigger micro-boosts at +2h, +8h, +24h. Also add accessibility check before publish (alt text present).
Publish-Bot: Received config request. Scheduled posts at 2026-05-18T08:30:00-07:00 and 2026-05-18T11:00:00-07:00. Accessibility check queued.
Ethan L (Design): Quick question: should clips include captions burned in? Recommend yes for X autoplay. Confirm?
Jules P (Social): Yes, burned captions please. Also supply VTT for LinkedIn.
Mina H (Content): I'll provide short timestamps and caption copy for each clip.
Sam K (Growth): KPI targets for first 48h: 500 registrants, 1500 click-throughs, 40 MQLs from paid seed. We'll revisit after 48h.
Tara C (Ops): SLA for monitoring? Who owns first 12h overnight coverage?
Jules P (Social): I can cover the US morning window. Tagging the EMEA on-call social rep for the night window @Lina (not in thread).
Mina H (Content): Final note: please ensure the hero has space on the right for headline overlay (avoid centered logo). I'll drop layout notes on the campaign Miro. Link: https://miro.com/redwood/webinar-may18
Sam K (Growth): Great. Action items recap: Mina update copy to "up to 3x" + memo link, Ethan exports assets by EOD, Jules drafts scheduling CSV and employee brief, Tara wires HubSpot tag + webhook, Sam uploads seedlist CSV. We'll reconvene once assets are in drive. :white_check_mark:
